description.value:
Applied by Fixed Point to the warded creature (you or 1 willing creature).

For 1 minute, the first time each creature tries to target the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell, it attempts a Will save; a given attacker only ever makes this save once per casting. Critical Success the attacker acts freely. Success the attacker acts normally. Failure that one action is wasted. Critical Failure as failure, and the attacker is off-guard against the warded creature until the start of its own next turn.
